        count_statement = select(func.count()).select_from(Item)

        statement = (

            .offset(skip)

    onSuccess: () => {
      showSuccessToast("The item was deleted successfully")
      setIsOpen(false)
      onSuccess()
    },
    onError: handleError.bind(showErrorToast),
    onSettled: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries()
    },
  })

  const onSubmit = async () => {
    mutation.mutate(id)
  }

  return (

    </Dialog>
  )
